response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medication (nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs) prescribed as part of treatment for an acute injury (ankle sprain) that occurred during a trip. Clause A4.1 explicitly covers the cost of medication prescribed by a doctor in the event of an acute illness or injury during travel. There is no indication that the injury was pre-existing, planned, or related to any exclusion (e.g., alcohol, extreme sports, war, etc.)."}
